scientific_boundary: No SDM fit, EOG support-topology result, bridge/reachability result, held-out performance, or outcome-based taxon selection was inspected before this freeze.

source_structure.paper_source_discrepancy_policy: Report the published 844-island description as literature context but use and audit the exact version-1.0 tables for computation; do not invent or impute an additional island.

metadata_only_list.reference: Robinson, T., et al. (1996). South Australia's offshore islands. Australian Heritage Commission: Canberra.
metadata_only_list.reason: The island_data row has no linked species_data row, no island name, no survey year, and no sibling list. The frozen source does not establish that it is a complete zero-species flora, so it is not interpreted as universal absence.

distribution_screen.surveyed_island_universe: unique islands linked to at least one species_data row

status_screen.canonical_species_only_hash_rule: UTF-8 CSV with header species, alphabetically sorted included species, LF line endings
